correctness.rationale: Core implication makes the designated principal elements a finite Boolean algebra; a core-preserving homomorphism therefore restricts to a unique inverse-image map. Finite join-generation forces its action on all downsets. Elementwise lifting verifies Heyting implication and a two-fiber decomposition verifies tensor. Each image is determined by a kernel partition; its core intersection recovers the partition, and image inclusion reverses refinement. Choosing representatives yields every image as an idempotent retract. The world-map Stirling, Bell and Dedekind formulas follow. Standalone exhaustive finite checks through four worlds pass 58,536 assertions, including 3,125 possible five-element selfmaps screened.

value.rationale: This answers a natural invariant problem for a well-studied semantic family: classify every embedded retraction, recover its order and size, and count exact endomorphic ranks. The anti-partition correspondence is a uniform structural theorem, not an isolated numerical observation; it relates the semantics of collapsing worlds to three standard combinatorial invariants and applies to both inquisitive and dependence operations.
